lines.text: A notebook is made of paper!
Many learners say: I bought a notebook to work from home.
Better: I bought a laptop to work from home.
A notebook is for writing on paper.
The second! I send emails on my laptop.

data.wrong: I bought a notebook to work from home.
data.right: I bought a laptop to work from home.
data.why: A notebook is for writing on paper.

native.tip: Em português “notebook” é o computador portátil; em inglês, o computador é “laptop”. “Notebook” é um caderno.
native.caption: Você também diz isso? “I bought a notebook to work from home.” 😅 O certo é “I bought a laptop to work from home.” Em português “notebook” é o computador portátil; em inglês, o computador é “laptop”. “Notebook” é um caderno. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “laptop”. Agora diga em voz alta “I bought a laptop to work from home.” e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: In Portuguese “notebook” is the portable computer; in English, the computer is a “laptop”. A “notebook” is for writing.
en.caption: Do you say this too? “I bought a notebook to work from home.” 😅 The right way is “I bought a laptop to work from home.” In Portuguese “notebook” is the portable computer; in English, the computer is a “laptop”. A “notebook” is for writing. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
